integrity: The proof specifies the full list-decoding rule, the all-size upper bound, a constructive design transformation, and a directly checkable q=7 certificate. Small-instance computations complement but do not replace design existence proofs. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact sharpness only for alphabet sizes q>=3 congruent to 1 or 3 modulo 6. The all-q upper bound does not establish sharpness elsewhere. Infinite existence relies on published Steiner-system existence results; priority is limited by indexed accessible literature.
title: Sharp two-list one-deletion capacity at length three for Steiner-admissible alphabets
